questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design advanced traffic routing using header-based rules and serverless NEGs, enabling cohort-driven canaries without modifying application code paths. Emphasizes per-cohort monitoring, safe rollback procedures, and Google-native tooling integration.

## Key Concepts
- Header-based routing with URL maps and traffic weights
- Serverless NEGs and Cloud Run service management
- Per-cohort traffic distribution and rollback strategies
- Cloud Monitoring metrics and SLO evaluation
- IAM role management and Secret Manager integration

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example URL map configuration for header-based routing
name: cohort-based-url-map
defaultService: https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/project-id/global/backendServices/v2-backend

hostRules:
- hosts: ['*']
  pathMatcher: cohort-matcher

pathMatchers:
- name: cohort-matcher
  defaultService: https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/project-id/global/backendServices/v2-backend
  routeRules:
  - matchRules:
    - headers:
        X-User-Cohort: A
    priority: 1
    routeAction:
      weightedBackendServices:
      - backendService: https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/project-id/global/backendServices/v3-backend
        weight: 20
      - backendService: https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/project-id/global/backendServices/v2-backend
        weight: 80
  - matchRules:
    - headers:
        X-User-Cohort: B
    priority: 2
    routeAction:
      weightedBackendServices:
      - backendService: https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/project-id/global/backendServices/v2-backend
        weight: 100
```

```bash
# Create policy

gcloud compute security-policies rules create 1000 --security-policy=partner-ip-policy --src-ip-ranges=192.0.2.0/24 --action=allow --direction=INGRESS
gcloud compute security-policies rules create 2000 --security-policy=partner-ip-policy --src-ip-ranges=198.51.100.0/24 --action=allow --direction=INGRESS

# Deny all other ingress
gcloud compute security-policies rules create 3000 --security-policy=partner-ip-policy --action=deny --direction=INGRESS

# Attach to backend
```

```bash
  --delivery-pipeline=my-pipeline \
  --images=app=us-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/app/v4:latest

# Sign and attest with both scanners
cosign attest --predicate type=vuln-scan ...

# Promote through regions
for region in us-central1 asia-northeast1 europe-west1; do

done

gcloud deploy releases rollback v4 --region=us-central1
```
